sentiment_evidence: Perfect, that's exactly my list. Thank you so much Riya.

issues.title: Thank-you page after checkout
issues.problem_statement: After checkout, the customer's buyers landed on the default thank-you page instead of the customer's own page.

issues.title: Landing page buttons on mobile
issues.problem_statement: On the customer's phone, the two buttons on their landing page overlapped each other.

issues.title: Emails going to spam
issues.problem_statement: The customer's emails are going to spam and they had read that they need to verify their email domain.

issues.title: Expired EARLYBIRD coupon
issues.problem_statement: The customer's EARLYBIRD coupon has expired and they are not sure whether they want to extend it.

issues.title: Company name on invoices
issues.problem_statement: The GST name on the customer's invoices shows their personal name instead of their company name.

issues.title: Weekly lesson unlock for course
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants the lessons of their course to unlock one per week for their students; the course is sold inside a bundle.

issues.title: AI quiz generator question
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked whether FlexiFunnels has an AI quiz generator, as a friend said it does.

issues.title: Exporting the student list
issues.problem_statement: The customer wanted to know how to export their student list.

items.description: Customer pasted their thank-you page link into the redirect field in the product's After purchase settings and saved it, following support's guidance, and a test order now goes to their thank-you page.
evidence: yes, it now goes to my thank-you page.

items.description: Customer increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view of the page editor, following support's guidance, and confirmed on their phone that the buttons are now separate.
evidence: yes, now they are separate, it looks fine.

items.description: Support explained that to verify the email domain, the customer adds their domain in Email settings, receives three DNS records, adds those records at their domain registrar and then clicks Verify.
evidence: In Email settings, add your domain and you will get three DNS records.

items.description: Customer will get their developer, who holds the registrar login, to add the three DNS records.
evidence: I'll get him to add the records by Friday.

items.description: Once the records are added, the customer is to click Verify in the email settings.
evidence: Once the records are added, click Verify in the email settings.

items.description: Support explained that if the customer decides to extend the expired EARLYBIRD coupon, they can change the expiry date in the coupon settings; the decision is the customer's.
evidence: If you decide to extend it, you can change the expiry date in the coupon settings.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about changing the GST name on the customer's invoices and get back to the customer.
evidence: I'll check with our billing team about changing it, and get back to you within 2 working days.

items.description: Support said there is a drip schedule setting for lessons.
evidence: There is a drip schedule setting for lessons.

items.description: Support is not sure whether the drip schedule works when the course is sold inside a bundle and will check with the product team and get back to the customer.
evidence: Let me check that with our product team and get back to you.

items.description: Support said they are not aware of a quiz generator being available right now and have no date for one, and advised the customer not to plan around it.
evidence: I'm not aware of a quiz generator being available right now, and I don't have a date for one.

items.description: Support explained that to export the student list, the customer goes to Students, clicks Export and chooses CSV, which downloads a file that opens in a spreadsheet.
evidence: Go to Students, click Export, and choose CSV.

items.description: Customer said they will try the student list export later.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
